prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a snow-covered trail under a starlit night sky. The camera captures the continuous fall of snowflakes, which gently settle on the ground, creating a serene and quiet atmosphere. As the viewer progresses, the trail curves slightly to the right, revealing a metal railing on the left side that guides the path. The surrounding landscape is dark, with faint outlines of rocky terrain and sparse vegetation barely visible against the night backdrop. The camera angle remains low, close to the ground, emphasizing the texture of the snow and the ruggedness of the trail. The lighting is minimal, primarily from the ambient glow of the stars, casting soft shadows and highlighting the undulating contours of the snowy path. The scene remains empty, with no other individuals present, enhancing the sense of solitude. The camera continues its smooth advance, occasionally adjusting to follow the natural bends of the trail, maintaining a consistent pace and direction throughout the journey.
